description: This file is a PHP source code file for configuring wireless network settings in a web interface. It contains server-side logic, HTML markup, embedded JavaScript for UI interactions, and PHP includes for headers and footers. The file manages Wi-Fi SSID configurations, security modes, channels, and related options, with some logic for different user roles and device states.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Fetches key-value pairs for wireless configuration parameters from external device management.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends reset/restore commands to the backend to restore Wi-Fi settings to default.
